newsitem.title: CHILE: No word on Codelco CEO Villarzu's replacement.
newsitem.headline: No word on Codelco CEO Villarzu's replacement.

text.p: There was no word Friday from Chile state-owned copper company Codelco on who would replace chief executive Juan Villarzu after his surprise appointment as President Eduardo Frei's chief-of-staff.
No officials at the corporation were immediately available to comment on Villarzu's departure.
Although the choice of Villarzu caught analysts off-guard, outgoing chief-of-staff Genaro Arriagada had been widely expected to be replaced in Frei's cabinet reshuffle.
Villarzu was appointed by Frei as Codelco's chief executive two years ago, replacing Alejandro Noemi who resigned after a futures scandal which cost the corporation $175 million in 1993.
